training-effectiveness.title: Training effectiveness
training-effectiveness.purpose: Kirkpatrick levels 1 to 4 for every course: reaction, learning gain, behaviour on the job and linked results, with small groups suppressed.

training-effectiveness-course.title: Course effectiveness
training-effectiveness-course.purpose: One course in depth: the four levels, the evidence behind each and the redesign decision.

training-observations.title: On-the-job observations
training-observations.purpose: Level 3: line managers observe how people apply a qualifying course 60 to 90 days after completing it.

my-learning-feedback.title: Course feedback
my-learning-feedback.purpose: Give short, anonymous feedback on the courses you completed in the last 90 days.

training-needs.title: Training needs forecast
training-needs.purpose: Demand per course and quarter from expiries, curricula, roadmaps, recommendations, future interest and knowledge-loss actions, against session capacity.

common.suppressedHint: Fewer than 10 people: the value is hidden to protect individuals
common.levelsShown: {n} of 4 Kirkpatrick levels have enough data

l1.name: Reaction
l1.what: Learners rate relevance, clarity, delivery, confidence and time right after the course. Anonymous to instructors.

l2.name: Learning
l2.what: Knowledge gain from a released check before the course to a released check after it.

l3.name: Behaviour
l3.what: The line manager observes, 60 to 90 days later, whether the course objectives show in daily work.

l4.name: Results
l4.what: Linked plant KPIs (SAMPLE). Association, not causation.

q.relevance: The course was relevant to my job
q.objectives: The objectives were clear and met
q.delivery: The instructor and materials helped me learn
q.confidence: I feel confident applying this at work
q.time: The course was worth the time away from work
q.recommend: Would you recommend this course to a colleague?

l1.scaleHint: 1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree. It takes under a minute.

eff.intro: How well each course works, at four levels: did people like it, did they learn, do they apply it, and what moved in the plant. Results show only for groups of 10 or more; plant KPIs are SAMPLE data and show association, not causation.
eff.labels: Groups under {n} are suppressed. Individual L1 answers are never shown.
eff.scheduleL3Consequence: Creates an observation 90 days after every completion of a qualifying course that has none yet, assigned to the learner's line manager. It is audited.

tile.coursesSub: At least one level with enough data

eff.scorecardHint: Open a course for the detail behind each level. "Why this?" lists the evidence.
eff.notAuthority: These measures help training committees improve courses. They never qualify, disqualify or rate a person; qualification stays with the licensee's systems.

flags.title: Courses flagged for redesign
flags.hint: Flags go to the SAT workbench (analysis, design and development) with the evidence of the day.
flags.none: No course is flagged for redesign

pack.title: Committee pack
pack.intro: Aggregate results for one training committee, prepared {date}. Values from groups under {n} print as <10.
pack.empty: No course reports to this committee
pack.caveat: L4 KPIs are SAMPLE data: association, not causation. Not a regulatory submission.
pack.csvNote: Kafa'a committee pack. Aggregates only; cells under {n} suppressed (<10). L4 KPIs are SAMPLE: association, not causation.

course.intro: The four Kirkpatrick levels for this course, each with the evidence behind it.
course.flagConsequence: The course goes to the SAT workbench with today's evidence. Committees see the flag. Audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
course.l1Small: Results show when {n} or more people have answered.
course.l1Anon: Answers are anonymous: instructors and managers see only these aggregates.
course.l2NoneHint: Link a before and after check in the evaluation design to measure the gain.
course.l2Small: The gain shows when {n} or more people have both a released before and after check.
course.l2Released: Only released attempts count; drafts and graded-but-unreleased results are left out.
course.l2Excluded: Some unreleased attempts are waiting and are not counted yet.
course.l3NotQualifyingHint: On-the-job observations are scheduled for qualifying courses only.
course.l3Small: Transfer shows when {n} or more observations are recorded.
course.appliedText: {n}% of the checklist items were observed in daily work (yes = full, partly = half).
course.l4Caveat: SAMPLE plant KPIs linked to this course. Many things move a KPI besides one course; read a trend as a question for the committee, never as proof.
course.l4None: No KPI is linked to this course

l3.intro: Level 3: did the course show up in daily work? The line manager observes 60 to 90 days after a qualifying course and rates each objective.
l3.notSignoff: This observation is about applying the course at work. It does not qualify anyone; task sign-offs stay in the qualification card.
l3.modeAll: All observations (training manager or auditor view)
l3.formIntro: Rate what you saw in the last weeks of normal work. "Not applicable" when there was no chance to observe it.
l3.noteHint: Up to 500 characters. Describe behaviour, not the person.

my.intro: Tell us how your courses worked for you. Forms stay open for {days} days after completion.
my.anon: Your answers are combined with others. Instructors, managers and the training team see course results only when {n} or more people answered, never your individual answers.
my.pendingHint: One short form per completed course.
my.nonePending: No feedback is waiting. Thank you.
my.noneGiven: You have not given feedback yet
my.l3Hint: After a qualifying course your line manager observes how it shows in your work. It is not a qualification decision.

needs.intro: How many people need each course next quarter, and why: qualification expiries, role curricula, knowledge-loss actions, career roadmaps, accepted coach recommendations and future interest, against the seats already scheduled.
needs.labels: Every number drills down to its sources. Cells under {n} are suppressed in exports but counted in totals.
needs.computeConsequence: Recomputes {q} from today's data in every source. Cells that no longer apply are set to 0. Audited.
needs.simBody: The intake adds the initial courses every new trainee needs. It is a what-if on this screen only: nothing is stored and drafts cannot be proposed from it.
needs.aggBody: Cells under {n} people show as suppressed. Totals are exact.
needs.empty: No demand computed for this quarter
needs.emptyCompute: Use "Recompute demand" to build it from the six sources.
needs.tableHint: Select a number to see where it comes from.
needs.proposeConsequence: Drafts sessions for {course} in {q} to cover {n} more people. Drafts are not published: the scheduler creates the sessions in the training schedule.
needs.draftsHint: Drafts appear in the training schedule as "not published" until the scheduler links a real session.
needs.dedupe: A person who needs the same course for two reasons in a quarter is counted once, under the first source in this list, so the sources always add up to the total.
needs.sumsMatch: The drill-down adds up to the cell.
needs.csvNote: Kafa'a training needs forecast. Cells under {n} print as <10 and are counted in the totals.

expiry.name: Qualification expiries
expiry.rule: The requalification course 90 days before a qualification expires (already expired: now). Mirror of the training records system.

mandatory.name: Role curriculum
mandatory.rule: Mandatory courses of the person's role: never completed (by the assignment due date) or a completion whose validity runs out.

klra.name: Knowledge-loss actions
klra.rule: Open cross-training actions from the knowledge loss risk assessment, by their due date.

roadmap.name: Career roadmaps
roadmap.rule: Course blocks in people's career roadmaps that have not ended, by their start date.

coach.name: Accepted recommendations
coach.rule: Courses people saved or enrolled in from the Learning Coach in the last 180 days, about 45 days later.

future.name: Future interest
future.rule: Interest in an advanced technology or horizon lane, through its linked course, about 120 days out.

schedule.title: Proposed from the training needs forecast
schedule.intro: Create the session with "New session", then link the draft to it. Drafts never appear to learners.
schedule.noSession: No session of this course in the quarter yet

reasons.l1_small: Fewer than {min} people answered the L1 form: results are suppressed
reasons.low_relevance: Relevance averages {v} of 5, below the {t} threshold
reasons.l2_none: No before/after knowledge check is linked, so L2 is not measured
reasons.l2_small: Fewer than {min} released before/after pairs: the gain is suppressed
reasons.l2_unreleased: Unreleased attempts are waiting and are not counted
reasons.l3_small: Fewer than {min} on-the-job observations recorded: transfer is suppressed
reasons.low_transfer: Only {v}% of the objectives were observed on the job (threshold {t}%)
reasons.on_track: Every measured level is above its threshold
reasons.shortfall: {n} more people than the {seats} seats scheduled
reasons.draft_cover: {n} seats are already in draft proposals
reasons.sim_short: Only {slots} free simulator slots in the quarter
reasons.src_mandatory: {n} people need it under their role curriculum
reasons.src_roadmap: {n} people planned it in their career roadmap
reasons.src_coach: {n} people accepted it from the Learning Coach
reasons.src_future: {n} people showed future interest that leads here
